pages.quiz:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the young one of a cow called? (1 mark)
   A. Kid
   B. Lamb
   C. Chick
   D. Calf

2. Which kitchen item helps to turn food in a pan? (1 mark)
   A. A spatula
   B. A ladle only
   C. A bucket
   D. A sieve

3. What is cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Cutting food
   B. Storing food
   C. Preparing food using heat
   D. Washing food

4. Why should we wear shoes? (1 mark)
   A. To hide our feet
   B. To protect feet from injury, worms and jiggers
   C. To make us tall
   D. To be heavier

5. How can you tell that water is boiling? (1 mark)
   A. The water is blue
   B. The water is cold
   C. Big bubbles rise quickly and steam comes off
   D. The water is still

6. Which of these is an indigenous chicken called in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. Layer only
   B. Broiler
   C. Kienyeji
   D. Turkey

7. Which of these is a protective food? (1 mark)
   A. Ugali
   B. Sugar
   C. Sukuma wiki
   D. Cooking oil

8. Why does drip irrigation save water? (1 mark)
   A. Water goes close to the roots so little is wasted
   B. It waters at midday
   C. It wets the paths between plants
   D. It uses more water than a hose

9. Which is a method of cleaning the home? (1 mark)
   A. Sowing
   B. Planting
   C. Mopping
   D. Grafting

10. Which of these can be made into a mop? (1 mark)
   A. A shoe
   B. A basin
   C. Strips of old cloth tied to a stick
   D. A chair

11. About how long is the long stitch in long and short tacking? (1 mark)
   A. 2 mm
   B. 2 metres
   C. 20 cm
   D. 2 cm

12. How far should mulch be from the stem? (1 mark)
   A. A small gap away
   B. Ten metres
   C. Not needed
   D. Piled tightly against it

13. What should you do after cleaning the house? (1 mark)
   A. Eat without washing
   B. Wash hands with soap
   C. Touch food
   D. Play in the dirt

14. What is the purpose of vaccinating animals? (1 mark)
   A. To make them noisy
   B. To prevent diseases
   C. To colour them
   D. To make them heavier

15. What do leaves do for a fruit tree? (1 mark)
   A. Use sunlight to make food for the plant
   B. Take in water from the soil
   C. Make the trunk
   D. Hold the tree in the ground

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain the meaning of domestic hygiene. (2 marks)

17. Describe how to make a bottle drip for one plant. (3 marks)

18. Why should vegetables not be boiled for a long time? (3 marks)

19. State three safety rules when cleaning PPE. (3 marks)

20. Describe how to keep a food journal for one week. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Calf
   A calf is a young cow or bull.

2. A — A spatula
   A spatula lifts and turns food.

3. C — Preparing food using heat
   Cooking uses heat to make food safe and tasty.

4. B — To protect feet from injury, worms and jiggers
   Shoes protect the feet.

5. C — Big bubbles rise quickly and steam comes off
   These are signs of boiling.

6. C — Kienyeji
   Kienyeji chickens are local breeds.

7. C — Sukuma wiki
   Vegetables give vitamins and minerals.

8. A — Water goes close to the roots so little is wasted
   Only the soil near the plant is wet, so less water is lost.

9. C — Mopping
   Mopping cleans floors.

10. C — Strips of old cloth tied to a stick
   A cloth mop works well.

11. D — 2 cm
   The long stitch is about 2 cm.

12. A — A small gap away
   Mulch touching the stem can cause rot.

13. B — Wash hands with soap
   Hands may carry germs.

14. B — To prevent diseases
   Vaccination protects animals from diseases.

15. A — Use sunlight to make food for the plant
   Leaves make food using sunlight.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keeping the home and its surroundings clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for keeping clean, 1 mark for the home.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make tiny holes in the cap, fill the bottle with clean water, bury the neck upside down near the plant, press soil around it and refill when empty.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for holes in cap, 1 mark for placing near plant, 1 mark for filling and refilling.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Long boiling removes vitamins into the water, so they lose their goodness.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Use soap and clean water; keep buckets and brushes from small children; wash your hands after; clean in an open place with drainage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

20. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw a table; write what you eat at every meal; write the group of each food; at the end of the week check which groups were missing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.
